info.title: Rafiq API
info.description: API for managing care services for children with Down syndrome

requestBody.description: The family information DTO containing Email, Relationship, Name, and EmergencyContact info.

200.description: Step 1 completed successfully, returns token and next step.

400.description: Validation failed (e.g., missing Email or invalid Relationship).

requestBody.description: The patient details DTO containing FirstName, LastName, DateOfBirth, Gender, and Token.

200.description: Step 2 completed successfully, returns token and next step.

400.description: Invalid token or step sequence, or missing patient data.

404.description: Registration session not found or expired.

post.summary: Step 3: Complete family registration by setting a password.

requestBody.description: The password DTO containing the registration token and password.

400.description: Invalid token, incomplete registration data, or invalid step sequence.

404.description: Registration session not found or expired.

get.summary: Resume a previously started registration process using the token.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The registration session token obtained from step 1 or 2.

404.description: Registration session not found or expired.

post.summary: Submit a new attempt for a session by uploading a video.

put.summary:
Review a patient's attempt by approving or rejecting it.
Specialists can also provide feedback and assign a score.

requestBody.description: Review details including status, feedback, and optional score.

get.summary: Get all pending attempts that require review by a specific specialist.
Retrieve all attempts submitted by a specific patient.

post.summary: Creates a new session with optional video and thumbnail uploads.

get.summary: Gets session details by session ID.
Gets all sessions for a specific specialist.
Retrieves sessions for a patient filtered by status.

parameters.name: patientId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the patient.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Optional query parameter to filter sessions:
`allowed` - sessions that match the patient's total score level.
`not-allowed` - sessions above the patient's total score level.
If not specified, all sessions for the patient will be returned.

200.description: Sessions found matching the status filter.

404.description: No sessions found for the patient or matching the specified status.

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred while retrieving sessions.

get.summary: Gets a specific specialist by ID.
Gets all patients assigned to a specific specialist.

404.description: Specialist not found or has no patients.

post.summary: Assigns a patient to a specialist.

409.description: Patient is already assigned to this specialist.

delete.summary: Unassigns a patient from a specialist.

404.description: Patient is not assigned to this specialist.
